id: title:andehen:protect recalculation results and cancellation cleanup

review.posthog_relevance: Adds checks and assertions to warehouse recalculation result storage, ensuring the stored row carries the recalculation fingerprint and status, and preventing duplicate row creation or overwriting when recalculation is terminal or missing.
review.reason: The chunk is dominated by documentation and test additions, but P1.F5.H3, P1.F5.H4, and P1.F5.H5 contain substantive implementation and assertion changes. P1.F5.H3 adds a recalculation ID and fingerprint to the stored result and checks that the row is updated in place. P1.F5.H4 passes the recalculation ID and fingerprint to the store-result helper and asserts the row's fingerprint.
review.uncertainty: The chunk also includes documentation and test-only changes, and the tier is assigned based on the implementation and assertion changes rather than the documentation and test additions.
